title: fan-out demo step
description: The step record of the fan-out demo, written to step.json at every step of a cycle. It narrates; the facts a viewer draws come from chant's own reports named under reports. Version 1 of the demo contract. Required fields are kept to a minimum: a new field is optional within contract 1, readers ignore fields they do not know, and a rename or removal is contract 2.

repo.description: The forge repository the demo runs on, <org>/<repo>.

cycle.description: The cycle the step belongs to.

scenario.description: The scenario the cycle plays, fan-out.

name.description: The scenario's display name, for example fifteen stacks.

title.description: The story's title, shown on every step.

step.description: Where the cycle stands. A step set gains a value only as an addition within a version.

chapter.description: The chapter the step belongs to. null only on the base and on a stall before the first step; a stall otherwise keeps the chapter before it.

at.description: When this step was written, ISO-8601.

next.description: What the driver does after the hold.

at.description: When the next step is due, ISO-8601.

pull.description: The pull request number the step concerns, null before one exists.

commit.description: The commit the step concerns: the head for a plan, the merge commit for an apply.

reports.description: Where chant's own reports for the cycle live. plan and apply are keys in reportKey(pr, commit) form, <pr>/<commit>, below url. The report files are pr-plan.json, pr-apply.json and the matching .events.jsonl.
